about.faq.0.a: Copy the link from the app's Share menu (Copy link), paste it into the box on the home page and press Download. Choose a quality and your browser starts saving the file straight away.
about.faq.0.q: How do I download a video?
about.faq.1.a: Your browser was asked to save the file but we couldn't confirm it started (some browsers hide this). Check your downloads. If nothing is there, use the “Save it here” link next to the quality.
about.faq.1.q: The page said “Download requested”. Did it work?
about.faq.2.a: On Android they go to the Downloads folder (or the Files app). On iPhone, Safari saves them in the Files app under Downloads; tap the download icon in the address bar to see them.
about.faq.2.q: Where do files go on a phone?
about.faq.3.a: The most common reasons are a private or deleted post, a post that needs a login, a region restriction, or a platform blocking server requests. The error message says which one applies.
about.faq.4.a: YouTube asks cloud servers to sign in to prove they aren't bots, and refuses our server even with every method we tested. We don't use accounts, cookies or paid proxies to get around platform restrictions, so YouTube isn't offered.
about.faq.5.a: When a post has more than one photo or video, each item gets its own preview and Download button. Tick the items you want, or press Select all, then Download selected as ZIP.
about.faq.5.q: How do I save several photos at once?
about.faq.6.a: Yes, very large or very long videos are refused to keep the service fast for everyone. The limit is shown in the error if you hit it.
about.faq.6.q: Is there a size or length limit?
about.faq.7.a: No. Only content that is publicly visible without logging in. YoniXTools never bypasses privacy settings, logins or DRM. Only download what you have the right to save.
about.install.android: Android (Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet): tap Install when YoniXTools offers it, or use the browser menu → Install app / Add to Home screen.
about.install.desktop: Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS (Chrome or Edge): click the install icon in the address bar, or menu → Install YoniXTools.
about.install.ios: iPhone and iPad (Safari): tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Safari has no automatic install prompt.
about.install.other: Firefox and other browsers: some don't support installing web apps; bookmark the site instead.
about.installNote: The installed app is this website running in its own window. It isn't a separate download from an app store.

privacy.adsP1: When advertising is on, YoniXTools shows ads from Adsterra, a third-party ad network. Ads are loaded in separate frames from a separate advertising address (ads.yonixtools.com), below or beside the tools, never inside them. Your browser keeps those frames apart from this site: the ad code can't see the links you paste, your files, your results or this site's cookies, and it can't redirect the page. Adsterra and its advertisers may use cookies, device identifiers and similar technologies in those frames to show, measure and limit ads, and they receive technical data such as your IP address, browser and the page you are on. See Adsterra's privacy policy for how they use it and your choices. You can block or delete these cookies in your browser settings, or use an ad blocker; the tools keep working either way.
privacy.adsP2: To place ads sensibly, each ad space reports to our own server only whether an ad appeared, came back empty or was blocked, with the ad position and whether the screen is phone- or desktop-sized. These are anonymous counts: no address, link, cookie or identifier is sent or kept.
privacy.adsP3: Advertising never decides whether a tool works: there are no forced ad clicks, countdowns or redirects, and pop-under or redirect ad formats are not used.
privacy.adsSuppressed: Advertising is currently switched off everywhere. Ads stay off until the ad network confirms in writing that gambling, adult and other unsafe ad categories are blocked for this site.
privacy.appP: If you install YoniXTools as an app, your browser keeps a copy of the site's pages and files so it opens faster and some pages work offline. Downloads and anything you process are never stored in that copy. Whether you dismissed the install invitation is remembered in your browser for 30 days.
privacy.browserP: Tools marked "Runs in your browser" process your images, files and text entirely on your device. That content is not uploaded to YoniXTools.
privacy.downloaderP1: Links you submit are sent to the YoniXTools server so it can fetch the public media. The prepared file is deleted automatically at most 15 minutes after it is ready, and never kept permanently. Server logs record the platform, timings and a short anonymous fingerprint of the link (never the full link or your files). Your IP address is used briefly in memory for rate limiting.
privacy.downloaderP2: Your recent downloads list is stored only in your browser and contains the title, platform and chosen quality, never the link. You can clear it from the downloader at any time.
privacy.geoP: To decide whether an ad may be shown in your country, our server looks up the country of your IP address in a local database, without storing the address or the result. IP geolocation by <link>DB-IP</link>, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Your country is never used to choose the page language.
privacy.languageP: The page language comes from the address you open (for example /es/ for Spanish). If you choose a language, that choice is stored only in your browser. Your browser's preferred language may be used to suggest a language, never to switch it automatically.
privacy.metaDescription: How YoniXTools handles your data: browser tools process files on your device, and only a theme preference and a recently-used list are stored locally.
privacy.monetagP: We may also show a small banner from Monetag on some tool pages (never on the downloader), loaded the same way in a separate frame. Monetag and its advertisers may use cookies, device identifiers and similar technologies, and receive technical data such as your IP address, browser and the page you are on. See Monetag's privacy policy. We don't use push notification ads, and nothing subscribes you to notifications.
privacy.storedP: Your browser's local storage holds your light or dark theme choice, your language choice, a short list of tools you used recently, your recent downloads list and the last quality you chose. They stay on your device, and clearing your site data removes them. YoniXTools does not set advertising or analytics cookies.
